Test.Text: select @A = t.A from tT t inner join (select J from T) l on l.C = t.H where B = 1;
Test.ResultText: select @A = t.A, X = l.N + 1, Y = 2 from tT t inner join (select J from T) l on l.C = t.H where B = 1;

Test.Text: update tT set A = 0 where B = 1;
Test.ResultText: update tT set A = 0, X = 1, Y = 2 where B = 1;

Test.Text: update x set A = 0 from tT x inner join (select J from T) l on l.C = x.H where B = 1;
Test.ResultText: update x set A = 0, X = l.M, Y = 2 from tT x inner join (select J from T) l on l.C = x.H where B = 1;
